meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Pimple Saudagar | D-SAP Ghule
meta.description: JEE coaching for Pimple Saudagar students, a short ride from our New Sangvi head office. Students from SNBP International School study with us.

h1: IIT JEE coaching in Pimple Saudagar
intro: Pimple Saudagar is about {{commute:pimple-saudagar#km}} km from our head office in New Sangvi, by way of Pimple Gurav.

sections.heading: From Pimple Saudagar to New Sangvi

body.text: Take Nashik Phata Road and Pimple Saudagar Road to Pimple Gurav, then the Pimple Gurav-Navi Sangvi Road to Krishna Nagar Road Number 2.

sections.heading: Pimple Saudagar students

body.text: Students from SNBP International School in Pimple Saudagar study with us.

body: Our Wakad branch is not much farther, so a family here can pick whichever centre fits the day better.

body.text: After Class 10, the two-year programme. Already in Class 12, the one-year programme. Either way, at most {{fact:batch.size}} students in the room.

questions.a: The [head office in New Sangvi](page:centre-sangvi-head-office), about {{commute:pimple-saudagar#km}} km away. The Wakad branch is a little farther.

questions.q: Do students from SNBP International School come to you?

a.text: Yes, students from SNBP International School study with us.

questions.q: Can my child switch centres later?
questions.a: Talk to us about it. Both centres teach JEE at the same times.
